create_tensor_computation_graph: create a ggml computation graph with tensors, operations, and compute the result
build_quantization_pipeline: build a quantization pipeline to convert float tensors to Q4_0, Q5_0, Q8_0, or K-series quantized formats
run_optimizer_training: run ADAM or LBFGS optimizer on a ggml computation graph for model training
test_backend_compatibility: test if a backend supports a specific tensor operation and compare outputs between backends
build_multi_backend_scheduler: build a backend scheduler to distribute computation across CPU, CUDA, and Metal backends
